description: Port Intel is a commercial data product of project44, a supply-chain visibility company, giving insight into port, terminal and vessel activity worldwide. The product page describes container import and export dwell times, vessel anchor and berthing durations, vessel counts and congestion for any route and port, with historical dwell trends to show changes in congestion and shipping volatility. Coverage: all global ports, shown on an interactive map with 20-metre precision to 11,800 berths, according to the page. Format and access: a web dashboard with snapshot views of chosen ports and visualisations for sharing with stakeholders; a test-drive map on the product page lets visitors select a port to see dwell times and vessel counts; full access through a demo request and sales contact. Cost: paid; prices were not read. Licence: proprietary; terms were not read. Caveats: the page does not state the data sources (for example AIS vessel positions or carrier milestones), the update frequency, the start of the historical series or whether an API or export is included; the test-drive map was not opened. Simulation uses: observed port congestion and dwell times to calibrate or validate port and maritime logistics disruption models, and to set baselines for freight network scenarios.
